snippet.title: Conan: The Black Pyramid | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Black Pyramid calls to warriors across time. Conan has answered.

Discover Conan: The Black Pyramid, a brutal roguelite action RPG where sword and sorcery meets cosmic horror.

Fight as Conan, Solomon Kane, Dark Agnes, and other legendary heroes from Robert E. Howard’s shared universe. Explore an ever-changing labyrinth beyond time, face nightmarish creatures, and uncover the dark secrets that brought you here.

Choose from five distinct characters, forge devastating builds, and turn chance to your advantage with dice that can unlock greater rewards. Master brutal combat and grow stronger with every attempt, alone or with a friend in 2-player online co-op.

Wishlist Conan: The Black Pyramid on Steam and sign up for the upcoming playtest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5367670/Conan_The_Black_Pyramid/

For more updates, news and sneak peeks, join the community: 
https://discord.com/invite/5sV9d25mgw

Follow us on social media:
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/conantheblackpyramid
• X: https://x.com/ConanPyramid
• TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@conanpyramid
